title: Playboy February 1993 Stephanie Seymour Danny DeVito Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear and a small nick at the bottom corner of the back cover. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:

Cover: Victoria's Secret supermodel Stephanie Seymour. Also: Playboy Interview with Danny DeVito; 20 Questions with Tim Allen; lingerie pictorial; An Appeal for Justice in Our Cities by Vincent Bugliosi.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
